description: A dark, smoky grey with a cool blue undertone. Deeper than silver and a strong modern look.
pickIf: you want a grey look that is darker and moodier than silver.
skipIf: your hair is dry or damaged, or you have a strict office.
weekly: Purple or silver shampoo once. Deep conditioner once.
suitsText: All skin tones · Any grey

faq.a: A dark, smoky grey with a cool blue undertone, deeper than silver.

faq.q: Do I need bleach for charcoal grey?
faq.a: Yes. Black hair is lightened to Level 6–7 first, then toned grey.

faq.q: How is it different from ash grey or silver?
faq.a: Silver is light and bright. Charcoal is darker and smokier.
Yes, towards a softer grey in 4–6 weeks. Silver shampoo keeps it cool.

barberSteps: Ask: itching from dye or bleach before? If yes, stop.
Cream on hairline and ears.
Bleach the whole head to Level 6–7.
Rinse. Dry lightly.
Tone with a cool charcoal grey shade.
Rinse. Deep conditioner.

name: Green
shortLine: Bold green colour for a standout look.
description: A bold, vivid green that stands out in any light. A fashion colour for a creative, confident look.
pickIf: you want a bold, creative look and can look after it.
skipIf: you have a strict office, or do not want to keep topping up the colour.
weekly: Wash with cool water and colour-safe shampoo. Colour mask once.
suitsText: All skin tones · No grey

faq.q: Will green show on black hair?
faq.a: Only after bleaching. The barber lightens the hair first, then adds green.
It fades in 3–4 weeks. Washing with cool water helps.
No. Fashion colours show best on evenly lightened hair, so grey is not covered.

faq.q: Can I go back to black later?
faq.a: Yes. The barber colours over it with black. Plan for a few weeks of fading first.

barberSteps: Ask: itching from dye or bleach before? If yes, stop.
Cream on hairline and ears.
Bleach the whole head to Level 8–9.
Rinse. Dry lightly.
Apply green from roots to ends.
Rinse with cool water. Conditioner.
bleach: Yes, whole head on dark hair

name: Caramel Highlights
shortLine: Soft caramel streaks on dark hair.
description: Fine, warm caramel streaks through the top, blended into your dark hair. Adds light and warmth without colouring everything.
pickIf: you want a warm, soft change and have some length on top.
skipIf: your hair is very short, or you want your grey covered.
weekly: Colour-safe shampoo. Conditioner 1–2 times.
suitsText: Medium and deep skin · No grey or some grey

faq.a: Fine, warm caramel-coloured streaks placed through the top of dark hair.
Yes, on the streaks only. The rest of your hair stays natural.

faq.q: Do they work on short hair?
faq.a: Not really. They need some length on top to show.
They grow out softly over 6–8 weeks, with no hard root line.

barberSteps: Ask: itching from dye or bleach before? If yes, stop.
Pick thin strands on top with a comb.
Lighten strands to Level 7–8.
Use foil or a highlight cap.
Check every 10 min. Stop at warm caramel.
Rinse. Tone if too orange. Conditioner.

name: Ash Highlights
shortLine: Cool ash-grey streaks on dark hair.
description: Fine, cool ash-grey streaks through the top of dark hair. A modern, Korean-style way to add colour without going all over.
pickIf: you want a modern, cool-toned change and have some length on top.
skipIf: your hair is very short, or you want warm tones.
weekly: Purple or silver shampoo once.
suitsText: Light and medium skin · No grey or some grey

faq.a: Fine, cool ash-grey streaks placed through the top of dark hair.
Yes. The streaks are lightened strongly and then toned ash.

faq.q: Why do ash streaks turn orange?
faq.a: Dark hair has warm tones that show as the toner fades. Purple or silver shampoo helps.
The streaks stay for months, but the cool tone softens in 4–6 weeks.

barberSteps: Ask: itching from dye or bleach before? If yes, stop.
Pick thin strands on top with a comb.
Lighten strands to Level 8–9. Check often.
Use foil or a highlight cap.
Tone the streaks ash grey.
Rinse. Conditioner.
